notes.title: Alive Hunter a Hunt Reborn 2025 is Here - Full Remake Release
notes.notes:
Alive Hunter 2025 version is finally ready to release, now the game are better than ever.
With improved 3D models and animations,  dive into the story of Steve from the beggining to his climax.

A city reborn, new quests are avaliable, enjoy the new content and explore the new reworked city.
5 Years after its initial release, Alive Hunter has returned, let's fucking go.
